description: Wire the loop into the app so it closes: record user evidence, run improvement cycles, show versions, roll back. Orchestrator uses the active learned config. Surface in API, CLI and UI.
steps: config.py: add learning_dir (home/learning). app.py: App owns EvidenceLog and ModelRegistry; the orchestrator perception stage (services/orchestrator.py _perception and the reports) uses the active overlay and records the learned version id in the run's stage output so a run states which version produced it. Existing runs and tests without learning must behave identically (empty config).

Annotations: when a hypothesis decision (accept/reject etc.) is set via app.annotations in server.py, also append hypothesis_feedback evidence with conditions {query_domain, concept_type} read from the run record; decision 'none' or delete is not evidence. Add App.correct_role(run_id, entity_label, role, note) which validates against ROLES, appends role_correction evidence, and returns the proposed clarification; also expose that the perception stage output entities can be edited via existing stage edit and that edit counts as correction evidence only when the role was changed by the user.

API under /api/v1 in server.py (follow the regex dispatch style and error envelope): GET /learning (active version, evidence counts, pending candidates, last gate report), POST /learning/corrections {run_id?, term, role}, POST /learning/cycle (build proposals from evidence, run the gate, activate or reject, return the before/after table), GET /learning/versions, POST /learning/rollback {to?}. All validation errors are 422 via existing ValidationFailed; no AI call is made here.

CLI in cli.py: `learn status`, `learn correct --term T --role R`, `learn cycle`, `learn history`, `learn rollback`. Output the measured before/after metric table, and say plainly when nothing changed or the candidate was rejected.

UI: add a small Learning panel in static/app.js and index.html (follow existing patterns and .kiro/steering/ui-design-system.md): shows active version, evidence counts, history with accepted/rejected status and gate table, a Roll back button, and role-correction control on perceived entities with a guessed role. Keep helpers pure in lib.js if possible and extend ui_helpers.test.mjs; run node tests only if node exists, else mark UNVERIFIED.

Honest explanation texts: the panel and CLI state that learning is limited to the lexicon overlay and conditional priors, that a gate on frozen sets protects against regressions, and that the gate cannot detect harm that those sets do not cover.

Tests (backend/tests/platform/test_learning_app.py, use existing test_server.py / test_cli.py harness patterns): end to end loop through the real HTTP server and the CLI in a temp home: run a discovery on text containing an unknown word, correct its role twice from two runs, run a cycle, show the next run labels that word role_source 'learned' with the version id, roll back and show it returns to unknown/previous; accept/reject annotations produce evidence with conditions; a rejected cycle leaves the active version unchanged; invalid role returns 422; ISOMORPH_HOME isolation.
acceptance_criteria: The end-to-end test demonstrates evidence -> proposal -> gate -> new version -> changed perception on a later run -> rollback
python3 ./isomorph learn status works in a temp ISOMORPH_HOME
Runs without learning data behave as before
